description: vLLM + Node Exporter dashboard for RTX/Qwen. Added an interactive output-tokens-per-second time-series near the top while retaining the top-row output TPS stat; moved speculative-decoding acceptance by position to the fifth row and request rate/success/errors to the following row. Includes the ultra-thin cloud-vs-local cost strip and NVIDIA-inspired visual theme: #76B900 green, dark gray, white, with amber/red reserved for operational warning states.

panels.title: TOTAL TOKENS (RANGE)
panels.description: Prompt + output tokens generated within the selected Grafana time range. The large value is a range total; the small sparkline shows rate/shape, not a cumulative counter.

targets.expr: sum(increase(vllm:prompt_tokens_total[$__range]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1) + sum(increase(vllm:generation_tokens_total[$__range]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1)

panels.title: OUTPUT TOKENS (RANGE)
panels.description: Generated/decode tokens within the selected time range.

panels.title: INPUT TOKENS (RANGE)
panels.description: Prompt/prefill tokens within the selected time range.

panels.title: CACHE-HIT TOKENS (RANGE)
panels.description: Prompt tokens served from the prefix cache over the selected range (vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source_total{source="local_cache_hit"}). High = heavy prefix reuse; the cost cards price these at the discounted cache-read rate.

panels.title: OUTPUT TOKENS / SEC
panels.description: Decode throughput only. This is the model actively producing answer tokens.

panels.title: KV CACHE USED
panels.description: Percent of vLLM KV cache blocks currently used. This is not total GPU memory; it is the allocated KV cache pressure.

targets.expr: 100 * (avg((vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1)) or avg((vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1)) or vector(0))

panels.title: PREFIX CACHE HIT RATE
panels.description: 0% can be normal if prefix caching is disabled or if prompts are not being reused.

targets.expr: 100 * ((sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1) or sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1) or sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1) or vector(0)), 1))

panels.title: TIME TO FIRST TOKEN P50 / P95 / P99
panels.description: How long users wait before the first streamed token appears. Sensitive to prompt size, queueing, and prefill.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))

panels.title: REQUEST HOPPER: RUNNING / WAITING
panels.description: Running = actively being served. Waiting = queued but not yet scheduled. Swapped = KV/cache pressure caused requests to be moved out of active GPU cache.

panels.title: MEMORY UTILIZATION
panels.description: Host RAM utilization from Node Exporter.

panels.title: CPU UTILIZATION
panels.description: Host CPU utilization from Node Exporter.

panels.title: ROOT DISK UTILIZATION
panels.description: Root filesystem space utilization.

panels.title: OUTPUT TOKENS / SEC OVER TIME
panels.description: Interactive output/decode token throughput over time. Hover to inspect exact output tokens per second while preserving the top-row OUTPUT TOKENS / SEC headline.

panels.title: TOKEN THROUGHPUT OVER TIME
panels.description: Prompt/prefill tokens and output/decode tokens per second over time.

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1) + sum(rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_total[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1)

panels.title: PROMPT VS OUTPUT TOKEN MIX
panels.description: Prompt tokens/sec indicates prefill/context ingestion. Output tokens/sec indicates decode generation. Large prompt bursts with low output TPS usually means context/prefill dominated workload.

panels.title: REQUEST RATE / SUCCESS / ERRORS
panels.description: API request flow. Non-2xx should normally stay at zero unless clients are disconnecting, timing out, or sending bad requests.

panels.title: QUEUE TIME P50 / P95 / P99
panels.description: Scheduler wait time before work starts. This is one of the clearest contention signals.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:request_queue_time_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:request_queue_time_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:request_queue_time_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))

panels.title: END-TO-END REQUEST LATENCY P50 / P95 / P99
panels.description: Total request duration from arrival to completion.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))

panels.title: INTER-TOKEN LATENCY / TPOT
panels.description: Time between generated output tokens. Lower is better for streaming responsiveness. Moved out of the top row because it is a latency diagnostic, not a throughput headline.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1)) or histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1)) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1)) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))

panels.title: VLLM ENGINE ITERATION LATENCY
panels.description: Engine iteration metrics if exposed by your vLLM version.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:iteration_tokens_total_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))

panels.title: PROMPT SIZE DISTRIBUTION
panels.description: Prompt token size distribution for completed requests.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))

panels.title: OUTPUT SIZE DISTRIBUTION
panels.description: Generated token size distribution for completed requests.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:request_generation_tokens_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:request_generation_tokens_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:request_generation_tokens_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance, job) up{job="vllm"} == 1))

panels.title: HTTP LATENCY BY HANDLER
panels.description: HTTP request duration by handler if FastAPI instrumentation is exposed.

panels.title: PROCESS RSS / CPU IF EXPOSED
panels.description: Python process metrics if exposed by your vLLM Prometheus client mode.

panels.title: LOAD / CPU CORE
panels.description: 1-minute Linux load average divided by CPU core count. Under 1.0/core normally means no CPU run-queue contention.

panels.title: NETWORK THROUGHPUT RX / TX
panels.description: Network receive/transmit bytes per second across non-container interfaces.

panels.title: DISK THROUGHPUT READ / WRITE
panels.description: Disk read/write bytes per second.

panels.title: CPU: USER / SYSTEM / IOWAIT
panels.description: CPU breakdown. Watch iowait if disk stalls line up with vLLM latency.

panels.title: MEMORY: USED / AVAILABLE / CACHE
panels.description: Memory used, available, and cache.

panels.title: NETWORK: RX / TX
panels.description: Network receive/transmit throughput over time.

panels.title: DISK: READ / WRITE BYTES
panels.description: Disk read/write bytes per second over time.

panels.title: DISK IOPS
panels.description: Disk operations per second.

panels.title: FILESYSTEM SPACE BY MOUNT
panels.description: Filesystem usage by mountpoint.
